title: The exploding whale
caption:
Oregon tried to delete a whale with half a ton of dynamite. It got uploaded to a car instead. 🐳
A blast pushes out in every direction, including up, so big chunks become projectiles instead of confetti.
What would you have done with the whale?
sources: Oregon Department of Transportation / Wikipedia, Exploding whale (Florence, Oregon, 12 November 1970; about half a ton of dynamite; blubber landed about a quarter mile away and crushed a car bought in a "Whale of a Deal" promotion)
